description: This policy controls the visibility of the HomeGroup shortcut on the Start menu. The possible values are 0 - means that the shortcut should be hidden and grays out the corresponding toggle in the Settings app, 1 - means that the shortcut should be visible and grays out the corresponding toggle in the Settings app, 65535 - means that there is no enforced configuration and the setting can be changed by the user.

options.displayName: The shortcut is hidden and disables the setting in the Settings app.
options.description: The shortcut is hidden and disables the setting in the Settings app.

options.displayName: The shortcut is visible and disables the setting in the Settings app.
options.description: The shortcut is visible and disables the setting in the Settings app.

options.displayName: There is no enforced configuration and the setting can be changed by the user.
